scope: Actual original-source URDF dynamics, production pipe task and independent MjModel/MjData per station. No mocap/equality attachments. Every pipe monitored at 1 ms for finite motion/integration; actual contacts monitored at 10 ms. Original R1 finger-contact model only; G1/C5 full robot collisions. Independent stations do not physically collide across worlds.
releaseScope: All eight pipes, not only the last selected pipe, must have actual dual-finger forces >0.015 N per side, actual lift >35 mm, correct color/slot, actual table normal >0.005 N, released fingers and speed <0.025 m/s for a further 3 seconds.

planningExecution.scope: Production background controller, real worker_threads transport and shipped worker service/parser/serialization. Only browser file fetch is adapted to Node readFile. All pending workers are polled asynchronously between complete shared 1 ms ticks; actual qpos/qvel/ctrl/time stay unchanged while planning. Worker computation uses the unchanged cooperative candidate iterator and original gates. No task motion executes in a worker.

carryObservationScope: Actual lift/transfer dual-finger retention, longest contact-loss span and object-to-TCP relative pose are aggregated every 10 ms. Saved keyframes are every 100 ms plus every phase/contact change. Retention/drift values are observational, not silently thresholded or inferred from successful endpoints; materially ballistic transport requires explicit review and cannot be advertised as a grasp.
planningObservationScope: Per-station runtime.advancePlanning wrappers attribute each actual Worker poll and completed result to that same runtime. Global drain assertions still require every complete qpos/qvel/ctrl array and every world clock/tick to remain unchanged throughout preparation. Ready-state history is private command metadata, not a committed physical task start.
